title: Our Story
intro: ALEXANDRIS was founded on a simple idea: shoes built to be resoled, not replaced.

sections.heading: Considered by Design
sections.body: Every pair starts with the leather — full-grain hides sourced from tanneries we've worked with for over a decade. We design in small batches, favouring longevity over trend cycles.

sections.heading: Made to Last
sections.body: Our ateliers build with a hand-finished edge and a sole made to be resoled, not replaced — Goodyear-welt construction more common in bespoke shoemaking than mass production. It costs more to make. It shows.

sections.heading: A Quieter Kind of Luxury
sections.body: No logos, no seasons that expire. Just shoes we'd wear ourselves, made the way we'd want them made.
